en_title: DC Studios Co-Boss Peter Safran Reaffirms Franchise Slate After Skydance Acquisition
cn_title: DC掌门重申收购后的项目计划
subtitle: 按好剧本走
opus_summary: 华纳被收购后，DC联席掌门表示，新东家认可团队的长期愿景，愿提供资源支持。动画项目正推进，下一部开拍的真人作品尚未确定，《绿灯侠》第二季仍待观察。

paragraphs.en: I spoke with DC Studios’ co-CEO and co-chairman Peter Safran this week about the status of the studio’s future projects now that Warner Bros. has been acquired by Skydance .
paragraphs.cn: 华纳兄弟已被Skydance收购。本周，我与DC影业联席首席执行官兼联席董事长Peter Safran聊了聊，了解影业未来各个项目的进展。

paragraphs.en: Our discussion ranged from DC’s newest release, Clayface , to their upcoming feature film, television and animated projects, including The Batman: Part Two , Man of Tomorrow , The People v. Gorilla Grodd , Mister Miracle , and what DC Studios co-boss and filmmaker James Gunn might direct after his Superman follow-up.
paragraphs.cn: 我们聊到了DC最新上映的《泥脸》，以及即将推出的电影、电视剧和动画项目，包括《新蝙蝠侠2》《明日之人》《The People v. Gorilla Grodd》和《奇迹先生》。此外，我们还谈到，DC影业另一位联席掌门、导演詹姆斯·古恩在拍完《超人》续作后，可能会执导什么作品。

paragraphs.en: My chat with Peter Safran follows. It has been edited for clarity.
paragraphs.cn: 以下是我与Peter Safran的对话。为使表达更清晰，内容经过编辑。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Congratulations on Clayface actually happening. Back in the day, the best we could have hoped for is a SyFy Channel movie. Like Man-Thing .
paragraphs.cn: IGN：恭喜《泥脸》真的拍出来了。放在以前，我们最多也就指望它能成为SyFy频道的一部电影，就像《类人体》那样。

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: Exactly, exactly. Well, thankfully, we all did grow up loving “ Feat of Clay" in the [Batman] animated series so, when [Mike] Flanagan came in to pitch us , he had a very, very receptive audience, that is for sure.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：没错，没错。好在我们从小都很喜欢《蝙蝠侠》动画剧集里的《Feat of Clay》。所以，当迈克·弗拉纳根来向我们介绍构想时，我们确实非常、非常愿意听他讲，这一点毫无疑问。

paragraphs.en: So, we've had a few things but it's only the third narrative feature to come out, which is probably not what one would necessarily expect when you're rebooting a whole universe. But we've always said that we're going to be driven by good screenplays, and Flanagan wrote a great screenplay.
paragraphs.cn: 我们已经推出了一些作品，但这只是上映的第三部剧情长片。要重启整个宇宙，这样的安排可能并不是大家通常会预料到的。不过，我们一直说，项目要由好剧本来推动，而弗拉纳根写出了一个很棒的剧本。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Clayface is going to be the first release under the new Skydance regime. I know you have to be circumspect about private conversations, but were you and James given any marching orders from David Ellison about what maybe he'd like to see from the DCU going forward?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：《泥脸》将是Skydance接管后上映的首部作品。我知道谈到私下对话时，你必须谨慎一些，但David Ellison有没有向你和詹姆斯下达什么指示，比如他希望今后的DC宇宙朝什么方向发展？

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: You know what, he was very complimentary about what we've done and just wants to give us the resources to keep doing what we're doing. I think he sees the long-term vision that we have and we certainly laid it out for him earlier this year, and he wants us to keep doing that.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：其实，他非常肯定我们已经做出的成果，只想给我们提供资源，让我们继续做下去。我觉得他理解我们的长期愿景，今年早些时候，我们也确实向他详细介绍过。他希望我们继续照这个方向推进。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Clayface is the smallest movie you guys have done. I like that it's basically the movie that doesn't get made much anymore, $40 million or whatever movie. Do you plan on making some more of these smaller films or is it a wait and see kind of thing?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：《泥脸》是你们拍过的规模最小的电影。我很喜欢这一点，它基本上属于如今已经很少有人拍的那类电影，预算大概4,000万美元(约合人民币3亿元)。你们打算再拍一些这种小规模电影，还是要先观望一下？

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: We've always said that our slate should have a very broad spectrum of tones and budgets and scales and scopes and this is just another example of us living up to what we said we were going to do. James and I are both pretty, and you and I have talked about horror for years, James and I are very steeped in the world of horror so the fact that we can make a full on R-rated body horror picture but under the banner of DCU and within the DCU is incredibly exciting, that's really a dream come true. And at its core, Clayface for us really represents exactly the creative flexibility that makes DC unique.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：我们一直说，片单应该涵盖非常广泛的基调、预算、规模和题材范围。这只是我们兑现承诺的又一个例子。你和我多年来一直在聊恐怖片，詹姆斯和我也都深耕恐怖片领域。因此，能够打着DC宇宙的旗号，在这个宇宙内拍一部彻底的R级身体恐怖片，实在令人兴奋，真的是梦想成真。对我们而言，《泥脸》的核心恰恰体现了让DC与众不同的创作灵活性。

paragraphs.en: So, from its conception, the project was never designed to be a traditional superhero movie, but it was always a character-driven story that uses DC mythology to explore obsession, identity, fame, transformation, to explore those themes. So, it really does represent the kind of thing that we were talking about early on, and I think that audiences really do crave things that feel different and this one truly does.
paragraphs.cn: 所以，从构思之初，这个项目就不是要拍成传统的超级英雄电影，而是始终以人物为核心，借助DC的世界观，探讨执念、身份、名声和蜕变这些主题。因此，它确实体现了我们早期谈过的创作方向。我认为观众确实渴望看到不一样的作品，而这部电影真的不一样。

paragraphs.en: I think that the genre approach, rather than following the conventions of a classic comic book spectacle, instead we're, and you saw the movie last night, we're leaning into the psychological body horror elements creating this really unsettling experience. And the character's ability to physically transform becomes a vehicle to explore these deeper human fears about identity and self-worth and losing control and there's a real story at its heart, there's a real character journey at the heart of this movie. And I always say that the best horror movie is, if you strip out the horror, there's still a good drama and I feel like that's what this is. It's got some real depth to it. I think people are going to be surprised when they see it and I think that that point of differentiation that you've never seen a comic book adaptation in the film world like this is something that audiences are going to grasp onto.
paragraphs.cn: 我觉得，我们在类型处理上没有遵循传统漫画大片的惯例，而是着重展现心理恐怖和身体恐怖元素，营造出一种令人非常不安的体验。你昨晚也看过电影了。角色改变身体形态的能力，成为我们深入探讨人类对身份、自我价值和失控的恐惧的切入点。这部电影的核心有扎实的故事，也有真正的人物历程。我总说，最好的恐怖片，即使去掉恐怖元素，依然是一部好剧情片。我觉得这部就是如此，它确实有深度。我想人们看了会感到惊讶。观众从未见过这样的漫画改编电影，我觉得这种与众不同之处会吸引他们。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Clayface is set in Gotham City. James has said it's in the DCU. How much of that should the fans actually take to heart? Will this be what Gotham City is going to look like when you finally make Batman: The Brave and the Bold ?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：《泥脸》的故事发生在哥谭市。詹姆斯说过，它属于DC宇宙。粉丝应该在多大程度上把这一点当真？等你们最终拍摄《蝙蝠侠：英勇无畏》时，哥谭市也会是这个样子吗？

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: What we've always said is that there's a consistency to the look but the next filmmaker that tackles Gotham, they [can] use it as a starting point, they can all feel different. I think each filmmaker, just the way great comic book creators treat stories differently within the same worlds and with the same characters in the comic books, we want each film to have its own reflection of the vision of the filmmaker. Listen, Gotham is a grittier, dirtier place, for example, than Coast City and I don't think, suddenly, Gotham's not going to become Paris, and so I think that that's always going to be consistent.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：我们一直说，视觉风格会保持一致，但下一位拍摄哥谭的导演可以把它当作起点，不同作品的感觉可以各不相同。优秀的漫画创作者会在同一个世界里，用同样的角色，以不同方式讲故事。我们也希望每部电影都能体现各自导演的创作愿景。比如，哥谭比海滨城更粗粝、更肮脏，它不会突然变成巴黎。我想，这一点始终会保持一致。

paragraphs.en: But I think, actually, [Clayface director James] Watkins did a really good job layering in the darker, grittier feel, but with also a slight glimpse like when you're inside his apartment before he gets turfed out of it. But you get a little bit of sense of what money can buy you in Gotham, there's an elegance to it as well, a Beaux-Arts brilliance to it that can exist but we all know that Gotham is a little dirty, is a little gritty, is a little dangerous.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，我觉得《泥脸》导演James Watkins确实做得很好，逐层营造出更黑暗、更粗粝的感觉，同时也让人窥见另一面。比如，主角被赶出公寓之前，镜头展现了公寓内部。你能稍微感受到，在哥谭，有钱能买到什么。这里也可以有优雅的一面，可以有布杂艺术风格（Beaux-Arts）的华丽。但我们都知道，哥谭有些脏，有些粗粝，也有些危险。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Now that Lanterns has wrapped up Season One , what is the plan for DC on television at this point?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：《绿灯侠》第一季已经收官，DC目前在电视剧方面有什么计划？

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: Well, we're obviously in production on Gorilla Grodd right now, we have a number of other properties that we're really excited about that we're in development on. The episodic world is always going to be a really important part of our overall slate. It's a great way to tell stories that need more real estate than a feature film can offer you, and it's a great way to introduce characters that we then bring into the feature world. And I think that Aaron Pierre and John Stewart are perfect examples of that. We introduced him in Lanterns and audiences will see him next summer in Man of Tomorrow. So, it's really important to us in continuing to tell aspects of the story that we're not telling in the feature film world so there's more to come.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：我们现在显然正在制作《The People v. Gorilla Grodd》，还有其他几个让我们非常兴奋的项目正在开发。剧集始终会是我们整体片单中非常重要的一部分。有些故事需要比一部长片更多的篇幅，剧集很适合讲这样的故事。它也很适合先介绍角色，再让这些角色进入电影。我觉得Aaron Pierre饰演的约翰·斯图尔特就是绝佳例子。我们在《绿灯侠》中介绍了这个角色，明年夏天，观众会在《明日之人》里见到他。因此，剧集对我们非常重要，让我们能继续讲述电影没有涉及的故事部分。接下来还会有更多作品。

paragraphs.en: Listen, we'll see what happens with Lanterns Season Two . If, I think, the collective group of HBO and DC and Chris Mundy and the team all feel like we've got something that is a worthy successor to quite a beloved first season of television, then I wouldn't be surprised to see more.
paragraphs.cn: 至于《绿灯侠》第二季，我们还要看看。我觉得，如果HBO、DC、Chris Mundy和团队都认为，我们有了一个足以接续这部颇受喜爱的第一季的故事，那么再推出后续作品，我也不会意外。

paragraphs.en: IGN: But Lanterns Season Two is not green lit?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：但《绿灯侠》第二季还没有获批，对吗？

paragraphs.en: IGN: What project do you think will be the next after Gorilla Grodd to go before cameras?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：你认为《The People v. Gorilla Grodd》之后，下一个开拍的项目会是什么？

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: There are a couple that are vying for that spot, but we haven't firmly committed to what the next one will be in either film or television. We have a pretty robust slate of animation that's all going forward right now but, on the live-action side, it's a little bit TBD.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：有几个项目都在争取这个位置，但无论电影还是电视剧，我们都还没有最终确定下一个项目。目前，我们有相当丰富的动画项目，都在推进。真人作品这边，则还未确定。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Obviously, just from a marketplace perspective, you don't want to have dueling Batmans out there.
paragraphs.cn: IGN：显然，单从市场角度来说，你们不会希望两个蝙蝠侠彼此竞争。

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: No. Listen, we know that we've got Batman: Part Two and [the animated film] Dynamic Duo in 2028. Listen, I couldn't be more excited about the plans that we have over the next five years and, obviously, a lot of them, we're just not able to talk about yet, but I think you're never going to please everybody, but I have a feeling that people are going to be excited about what we have coming up. And, again, Batman: Part Two, everybody's aware of the issues we're having right now , but, what we've seen so far of the shoot, it looked absolutely fantastic and Matt Reeves is a supremely talented filmmaker. Dynamic Duo is, for my money, as original today as Pixar was when they did Toy Story so we're really excited about that. Obviously, Man of Tomorrow's in post [production] right now.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：不会。我们知道，2028年会有《新蝙蝠侠2》和动画电影《Dynamic Duo》。我对我们未来五年的计划无比兴奋。当然，其中很多现在还不能谈。你永远无法让所有人满意，但我感觉，人们会对我们接下来的作品感到兴奋。再说回《新蝙蝠侠2》，大家都知道我们目前遇到的问题，不过，就我们目前看到的拍摄素材而言，效果非常棒，马特·里维斯是一位才华极高的导演。在我看来，《Dynamic Duo》在今天展现出的原创性，不亚于皮克斯当年制作《玩具总动员》时的表现，所以我们非常期待它。当然，《明日之人》目前正在后期制作。

paragraphs.en: IGN: On that television front, you did announce some interesting animated projects at the Annecy festival . What can you tell us about where some of those are right now?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：说到电视剧，你们在安纳西动画节上公布了一些很有意思的动画项目。能向我们介绍一下其中一些项目目前的进展吗？

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: Somewhere in early stages. Absolute Batman , (Scott Snyder’s) just working on the scripts right now. Mr. Miracle, I think that Tom King really learned a lot in his season of co-creating and executive producing Lanterns and he adapted his book Mr. Miracle fully on his own, wrote all eight episodes and I think it's just dynamite. Josh Hutcherson as Scott Free and Mackenzie Davis as Big Barda. And I just think it's a book that I've always loved and I remember Tom telling us early on that, every convention he goes to, at least a couple people come up to him and say this book saved my life and I love that we got to tell that story over eight episodes. And it's just a beautiful story about, “How do we survive in today's world knowing that we're never going to truly know the answers to the big questions in life?” It's a beautiful book and the adaptation is fantastic so we're excited about that.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：有些还处于早期阶段。《Absolute Batman》目前由Scott Snyder撰写剧本。至于《奇迹先生》，我觉得Tom King在共同创作并担任《绿灯侠》一季执行制片人的过程中，确实学到了很多。他独立改编了自己的漫画《奇迹先生》，写完了全部八集。我觉得剧本精彩极了。Josh Hutcherson饰演斯科特·弗里，Mackenzie Davis饰演大芭达。我一直很喜欢这部漫画。我记得Tom很早就告诉过我们，每次参加漫展，都至少有几个人走上前对他说，这部漫画救了自己的命。我很高兴我们能用八集讲述这个故事。它非常美，探讨的是：我们知道自己永远无法真正得知人生重大问题的答案，那么，该如何在今天的世界中生存？原作很美，改编也非常出色，所以我们很期待。

paragraphs.en: IGN: And that Joker anime sounds really interesting.
paragraphs.cn: IGN：那部小丑题材的日式动画听起来也很有意思。

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: Yeah, that's one of the earlier phases of development, working on the scripts right now. The ones that are really advanced are Creature Commandos Season Two, Mr. Miracle, My Adventures with Green Lantern, Starfire and DC Superpowers. Those are all creatively way down the road. So, we're really excited because we love animation, we love the art form and the fact that we're going to have such a robust slate coming out is fantastic.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：是的，那个项目还处于比较早期的开发阶段，目前正在写剧本。进展比较靠前的是《生物突击队》第二季、《奇迹先生》《My Adventures with Green Lantern》《Starfire》和《DC Superpowers》。这些作品的创作都已经推进了很远。我们很兴奋，因为我们热爱动画，热爱这种艺术形式。能够推出这样丰富的一批作品，实在太棒了。

paragraphs.en: IGN: When do you think the marketing push and reveals will start happening for Man of Tomorrow?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：你认为《明日之人》什么时候会开始宣传，并公布更多内容？

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: I think it's early days, it's early days. That's something that we'll determine in the coming month.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：我觉得现在还早，还早。我们会在接下来的一个月里决定这件事。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Has David Ellison mentioned at all any ideas or changes in how to market the DC movies or no?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：David Ellison有没有提过任何关于DC电影宣传的想法，或者想做什么改变？

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: No, not yet. But, remember, the whole thing's a week old, it was literally last Tuesday.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：没有，还没有。不过，别忘了，这件事才过去一周，就在上周二。

paragraphs.en: IGN: They just painted the Warner Bros. water tower .
paragraphs.cn: IGN：他们刚给华纳兄弟的水塔重新刷了漆。

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: Yeah, it's early days. But it's a coming home for us with [theatrical marketing and distribution executive] Josh Goldstine though to have him back involved in our movies as head of marketing and distribution and he's terrific, super smart and we've got a great relationship with him. So, I think that everything's to be discussed as we move forward. But, listen, they're already jumping in on Clayface, everybody's excited about that release and so it's great to be able to talk to Josh again about our business.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：是啊，现在还早。不过，负责院线电影营销和发行的Josh Goldstine回归，以营销和发行主管的身份重新参与我们的电影，对我们来说就像回到了家。他非常出色，也非常聪明，我们和他的关系很好。所以，我觉得随着工作推进，一切都还有待讨论。不过，他们已经开始参与《泥脸》的工作了，大家都很期待这部电影上映。能再次与Josh聊我们的业务，感觉很好。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Has James Gunn decided the next movie he's going to direct yet?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：詹姆斯·古恩决定下一部要执导的电影了吗？

paragraphs.en: IGN: He could probably use a bit of a breather, I suppose.
paragraphs.cn: IGN：我想，他可能也需要稍微喘口气。

paragraphs.en: Peter Safran: He really loves what he does. There was that time where he was writing the full season of Creature Commandos and writing and directing Peacemaker Season Two and prepping the first Superman movie . So, he's got a never-ending enthusiasm and excitement for what we're building so I wouldn't expect him to take too much time in between Man of Tomorrow and whatever he does next.
paragraphs.cn: Peter Safran：他真的很热爱自己的工作。有一段时间，他既在写《生物突击队》整季的剧本，又在编写和执导《和平使者》第二季，还在筹备第一部《超人》电影。他对我们正在构建的世界始终充满热情和兴奋。所以，我不认为他会在《明日之人》和下一部作品之间休息太久。

paragraphs.en: IGN: I want to be very delicate about how I ask this. Is there any scenario where Batman: Part Two doesn't start filming again?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：这个问题我想问得非常谨慎。有没有任何可能，《新蝙蝠侠2》不会恢复拍摄？
